=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:306-312 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The kill switch SECURITY_AUDIT_TRACKER_PIPELINE_EXCLUDE_ENABLED is compared to the literal "false" instead of using is_truthy normalisation. Values such as 0, no, off and FALSE therefore leave the tracker excluded. On the sweep-only path (exit at lines 371-375) the normalisation at lines 3271-3277 never runs.
  WHY: The shell paths and the full poller disagree on the same value, and the documented "false restores previous behaviour" contract only holds for the literal "false". Severity disagreement: Sonnet and GLM rated it NIT, Gemini and MiniMax rated it MAJOR. Sonnet could not verify that the sweep-only exit runs before the normalisation block. Sonnet says the claim about line ~26955 does not hold because run_unblock_scan runs after normalisation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27624-27663,27753-27755 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The security-audit tracker cleanup guard only runs for candidates found through the seven pipeline phase labels or standalone markers. A tracker with only ai:security-audit and ai:blocked is never a candidate, so ai:blocked is never stripped.
  WHY: The unblock selector skips the tracker (unblock_scan.py:345-349), so the stale label stays indefinitely. Severity disagreement: Sonnet rated it NIT (cosmetic residue), the others MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:385,1075-1099,1227,1623,1695,1715-1877,1843,1916-1952 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The workflow steps do not forward SECURITY_AUDIT_TRACKER_PIPELINE_EXCLUDE_ENABLED from vars.* into the poller processes.
  WHY: The script always sees its default of true, so setting the repository variable to false has no effect and the documented rollback is unreachable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27532-27577,27753 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _security_audit_tracker_stall_guard logs outcome=cleaned after a single gh issue edit and never re-fetches the issue to confirm the label removal persisted. It then bypasses the rest of the stall-recovery machinery.
  WHY: If the label edit is delayed, the log claims the tracker is clean when it may not be, and post-incident analysis is harder.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Kill switch SECURITY_AUDIT_TRACKER_PIPELINE_EXCLUDE_ENABLED defaults to true, and setting it to false restores the previous behaviour (issue summary, changelog and agents fragment).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (full-poller steps, sweep-only step, standalone recovery and unblock scan steps), workflow-templates/ai-orchestrate-poll.yml, and an assertion in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No workflow file mentions the variable, the PR diff touches no workflow file, and no workflow contract test was added. The script therefore always uses its true default, so the repository-variable rollback is unreachable. Severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER (MiniMax rated it BLOCKER). The workflow file is outside the plan grant's files_touched.
- requirement: The PR must use `Refs #3576`, not an auto-close keyword.
  expected_change_site: The PR description/body
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body reads "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/3576". Merging would auto-close the long-lived tracker. scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py only guards ai:orchestrator-tracking issues, so it did not catch this. Severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER (Gemini rated it BLOCKER).
- requirement: If the tracker carries `ai:blocked` or a phase label, remove those labels and log `STALL_RECOVERY_SKIP`.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, standalone stall recovery candidate discovery (lines 27624-27663)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The candidate queries do not discover an issue carrying only ai:blocked, so that case never reaches the guard at lines 27753-27755.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  PROBLEM: _unrouted_blocked_candidate_numbers compares the raw env value to the literal "false". The is_truthy normalisation at lines 3267-3277 only runs on the full-poller path. The reviewer did not verify whether the sweep-only early exit at lines 371-375 runs before that block.
  WHY: Values such as FALSE, 0, off and no leave the tracker excluded, so this path disagrees with the full poller. run_unblock_scan runs after normalisation, so Gemini's claim about line ~26955 does not hold.

  WHY: The unblock selector skips the tracker (unblock_scan.py:345-348), so ai:blocked stays. The residue is cosmetic because nothing dispatches work on the tracker.

  WHY: The documented repository-variable kill switch never reaches the poller, which always sees the default true.

  Evidence of absence: No hunk touches a workflow file, and the new tests only check shell text. Wiring it in needs a file outside the plan grant. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  Evidence of absence: The PR body reads "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/3576". lint_pr_body_auto_close.py only guards ai:orchestrator-tracking issues. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:306-312,26953,27546 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The kill switch is compared as a raw string "false" instead of using is_truthy, unlike the normalisation block at lines 3271-3277. It also drifts from unblock_scan.py:346, which uses .strip().lower() != "false".
  WHY: An operator setting 0, no, off or FALSE still gets the tracker excluded, so the "false restores previous behaviour" contract holds only for the literal "false".
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27753-27755,27624-27663 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard only runs for issues already in the candidates array, which is built from the seven phase labels and standalone markers. A tracker with only ai:blocked plus ai:security-audit, or one that has lost its phase label, never enters the batch.
  WHY: The symptom the PR is meant to fix (ai:blocked accumulating on the tracker) is left unremediated in the most common residual state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:371-375,306-312,3271-3277 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sweep-only path (RECLARIFY_REQUEUE_SWEEP_ONLY=true) calls detect_unrouted_blocked_comments and exits at lines 371-375, before the is_truthy normalisation at lines 3271-3277 runs.
  WHY: The sweep-only run keeps excluding the tracker after an operator sets the variable to false, 0 or no, diverging from the documented contract.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27532-27577,27753 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard removes multiple labels in one gh issue edit with no post-confirmation. It uses continue on success, which bypasses the rest of the stall-recovery machinery. outcome=cleaned conflates "API call succeeded" with "tracker is quiescent".
  WHY: If the label persist is delayed, no retry happens and the log may claim cleaned while the durable state is not.

  Evidence of absence: rg for the variable under .github/workflows and workflow-templates/ returns zero matches, and the changed-files list has no workflow file. The default true means the documented rollback is unreachable. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5

  Expected change site: PR description/body
  Evidence of absence: The PR description reads "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/3576". lint_pr_body_auto_close.py only flags ai:orchestrator-tracking issues, so CI misses it. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
